chapter: Second session: boyhood, brothers and early road years
title: Music in the family: mother, father, Anna and Viola's concert work
summary: Only the siblings were truly musicians; his mother's lessons came to little, his father reputedly played violin, Anna played piano and worked in the store, and Viola gave church concerts.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Ohhhh, wonderful. You made a statement in one of the interview articles that all your family was musicians. You meant your brothers and sisters, right?
Yeah.
Because you said your mother was taking lessons from Miss Augustine...
Well, you know, the kids was all taking lessons --my brother and a sister--and she went along, and she took lessons, too, but hers didn't amount to nothing.

SPIKES - 49
Reel 2
Page 15
How about your father? Did he...?

Well, they said he played violin but...but I never heard him. It was before I was born. I guess he played that country violin, you know. But that's what I heard. I don't know for sure. I never heard him try to play.
Mmmhmmmm. How about Anna? Did she play an instrument?
She played piano fairly well in her younger days. As she grew old, she got away from it.
Which sister was it that worked with you at the store you had in Los Angeles?
That's Anna.
That's Anna...because I wasn't sure about that. And you said Viola went to Europe with the Tuskegee Jubilee Singers?
Yeah. She travelled...
And she also, you said, did concerts in churches --was that...that was in this country?
Well, all the...yeah, a lot of places in this country she did concerts in churches and things like that.
Solo concerts?
Yeah.
And then she appeared with the Singers. Did she work with anybody else?
Not that I know of. She played for, you know, she was a...well, I don't know whether you'd call her a commercial

musician or not but she played for different singers in different churches and things, and she'd play a few pieces she...after she got married early, and that was...you know.
Do you remember what year it was that she was with the Tuskegee Jubilee Singers?
No, I don't.
